rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term when the political context makes it clear that the person is a legislator.

example.english: This legislator made a very reasonable speech in the council.
example.traditional: 呢位議員喺議會入面發言，好有道理。
example.jyutping: nei1 wai6 ji5 jyun4 hai2 ji5 wui2 jap6 min6 faat3 jin4 hou2 jau5 dou6 lei5

rows.note: Use this specifically for a member of Hong Kong's Legislative Council.

example.english: We can raise this issue with the legislator in the Legislative Council.
example.traditional: 我哋可以向立法會議員反映呢個問題。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 hoeng3 laap6 faat3 wui2 ji5 jyun4 faan2 jing2 nei1 go3 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this formal term when referring generally to someone who makes laws rather than naming a particular legislature.

example.english: A legislator should consider the lives of ordinary citizens when making laws.
example.traditional: 立法者制定法律時，應該考慮普通市民嘅生活。
example.jyutping: lap6 faat3 ze2 zai3 ding6 faat3 leot6 si4 jing1 goi1 haau2 leoi6 pou2 tung1 si5 man4 ge3 saang1 wut6
